evidence.text: Eragrostis intermedia is a species of grass known by the common name plains lovegrass.

evidence.title: Eragrostis intermedia
evidence.text: It is native to North and Central America, where it is distributed from the southeastern and southwestern United States south to Costa Rica.

evidence.title: Eragrostis intermedia
evidence.text: Its range may extend to South America.

evidence.title: Eragrostis curvula
evidence.text: Eragrostis curvula is a species of grass known by the common name weeping lovegrass.

evidence.title: Eragrostis curvula
evidence.text: Other common names include Boer lovegrass, curved lovegrass, Catalina lovegrass, and African lovegrass.

evidence.title: Rhexia
evidence.text: Rhexia is a plant genus of Melastomataceae (ca. 4500 species in 150 genera) family.

evidence.title: Rhexia
evidence.text: "Rhexia" species are commonly called “meadow beauty” and 11 to 13 species of "Rhexia" have been recognized depending on different taxonomic treatments.

evidence.text: Eragrostis is a large and widespread genus of plants in the grass family, found in many countries on all inhabited continents and many islands.

evidence.text: Cyperus eragrostis is a species of sedge known by several common names, including tall flatsedge, nutgrass, tall nutgrass, umbrella sedge, chufa, Earth almond, zula nuts, edible galingale and pale galingale.
